Frontier is represented by expectedFrontier + DependencyProof.baseFrontier + frontierPolicy; policy/trust history is preserved in OwnerInputBinding/branchEvidence/bundle/declaration pins/derivedPlan. portable_frontier_state and policy-history never appear as DependencyKey kinds |
